reference-contributor.name: BDD accessibility knowledge contributor
reference-contributor.purpose: Contribute approved accessibility review guidance to story generation.
reference-contributor.instructions: Use only the supplied reference guidance and report missing acceptance criteria without inventing requirements.
reference-contributor.knowledge: Review approved stories for observable keyboard access and accessible control names when accessibility is explicitly in scope.

changed-reference.name: BDD accessibility knowledge contributor
changed-reference.purpose: Contribute revised accessibility review guidance to story generation.
changed-reference.instructions: Use supplied acceptance criteria and approved source evidence. Record owner questions for unspecified requirements.
changed-reference.knowledge: Review approved stories for observable keyboard access, accessible control names and focus restoration when explicitly in scope.

review.note: Reviewed the fixture source, workflow scope and source-grounding limitations.
